title: Why America And Iran Are Always Fighting
sources: Britannica, "Anglo-Iranian Oil Company" and "Mohammad Mosaddegh" (royalties of about 16 percent; 1951 nationalization)
CIA, "Campaign to Install Pro-Western Government in Iran" (declassified, 2013) / US State Department FRUS 1952-1954 Iran (TPAJAX, 1953)
Britannica, "Iranian Consortium Agreement of 1954" (US companies 40 percent) and "SAVAK"
US National Archives / Jimmy Carter Library, "The Iran Hostage Crisis" (52 hostages, 444 days, Nov 1979 - Jan 1981)
Britannica, "Iran-Iraq War"; Foreign Policy (2013), CIA files on US intelligence support to Iraq
US State Department, Joint Comprehensive Plan of Action (2015) and US withdrawal (May 2018)
Reuters / AP coverage, 2025: failed US-Iran talks, Israeli and US strikes on Iranian nuclear sites (June 2025), UN snapback sanctions (Sept 2025)

lines.text: Why are America and Iran always fighting?

lines.text: It all started with oil.

lines.text: Iran sits on some of the largest oil reserves on Earth.
